stem_book: Fig. shows a flywheel of radius 10 cm. Its moment of inertia about the rotation axis is 0.4 kg-m². A massless string passes over the flywheel and a mass 2 kg is attached at its lower end. Angular acceleration of the pulley is nearly (take g = 10 m/s²): (a) 4.8 rad/s² (b) 6.2 rad/s² (c) 3.2 rad/s² (d) 9.6 rad/s²
reason: Added g = 10 m/s² (gives 4.76 ≈ 4.8; with 9.8 it is 4.67, still nearest (a)).
